status: Implemented and unit-tested on synthetic tracks. Value ranges on real pool video are not yet measured (M1-03 last criterion).
notes: Features are recomputed every processed frame over the last window_s seconds of the track's ring buffer and written to TrackObs.features.
step_s is the spacing at which training samples are taken from that stream (Blueprint M6: a vector every 0.5 s).
A feature is omitted from TrackObs.features when there is not enough data; it is never filled with a guess.
Features describe motion and visibility only. None of them, alone or together, is proof of distress or drowning.

features.name: speed_mps
features.definition: Net pool displacement between the first and last visible in-water samples of the window divided by their time span.

features.name: path_speed_mps
features.definition: Length of the path through all visible in-water samples of the window divided by their time span.

features.name: progress_ratio
features.definition: Net displacement divided by path length; near 0 means moving in place, 1 means a straight line.
features.available_when: speed features available and path length > 0

features.name: bob_std_norm
features.definition: Standard deviation of the box-centre image y over visible samples divided by the mean box height (vertical bobbing).

features.name: bob_freq_hz
features.definition: Dominant frequency of the box-centre y oscillation: uniform resampling, mean removal, zero-padded real FFT, strongest non-DC bin.
features.available_when: >= 8 visible samples spanning >= 2 s, bob_std_norm >= 0.02, and at least one full cycle in the span

features.name: visibility_ratio
features.definition: Fraction of window samples in which the track was visible (state tracked). Proxy for head visibility until a head detector exists.

features.name: time_since_seen_s
features.definition: Seconds since the track was last visible.

features.name: box_aspect
features.definition: Current box height divided by width (coarse posture cue; not a verticality measurement).

model_vector.layout: values of features in the order above, then one presence flag (1/0) per feature

planned_not_implemented.name: head_visible_ratio
planned_not_implemented.blocked_by: needs a pool-trained head detector (M1-09/M1-10, data)

planned_not_implemented.name: body_verticality
planned_not_implemented.blocked_by: needs pose keypoints; pose usefulness on pool video unverified (M1-06, data)

planned_not_implemented.name: motion_energy
planned_not_implemented.blocked_by: optical flow per track crop; deferred until the latency budget is measured on real video (I0.5)
